metadata.title: RULE AND RUIN | COMMANDFALL UNIT CODEX
metadata.design_status: Proposed combat values and active/passive abilities; established names preserved for the original six factions.
metadata.note: Core faction identities are grounded in the Rule and Ruin Lore Sheet (1).docx. Combat values, movement rules and unit abilities are new design proposals, not canon stated by that source.

build_scope.import_guidance: Filter unit.canonical_status == established_name to load the 156 original roster names. Cyborg Elf names are proposals, default off.

battle_modes.planetary: Infantry, specialists, commanders and ground vehicles on a planetary hex board.
battle_modes.orbital: Fighters through capital ships on a 2D orbital hex board. Same turn economy; different terrain and ship classes.

rules.coordinates: Axial (q,r). Six primary neighbors: (1,0),(1,-1),(0,-1),(-1,0),(-1,1),(0,1). Hex distance = (abs(dq)+abs(dr)+abs(dq+dr))/2.
rules.turn_structure: Alternating single-unit activation. Each surviving unit activates once per round. On activation it may move according to its pattern, then choose one basic attack OR one active ability, or wait. An active that moves/attacks uses that action; no bonus attack unless expressly provided.
rules.damage: No random hit, critical, dodge or damage rolls. A direct hit needs a legal target, range and line of sight. Compute max(0, raw damage - defender ARM - cover reduction); subtract that effective damage from temporary shields first, then any remainder from HP. Piercing abilities ignore named ARM, not shields. Area attacks hit all eligible occupants, friendly or enemy if specified.
rules.vision: Sight blocked by tall obstacles and walls, not low cover. Reveal and shared vision are deterministic; range and LOS still apply unless skill states otherwise. No fog randomization.
rules.battle_end: Leader objective: killing the opposing nominated Captain/Commander on ground or Flagship in orbit ends the battle immediately, regardless of remaining forces. The hit must legally deal lethal damage after ARM, cover, shields and a declared GUARD intercept. Ordinary captures never substitute for destroying the protected enemy leader.
rules.guard: A defender can be protected only by an actual guard ability/passive, shield, terrain or formation. Guards intercept at most one eligible direct attack per round, never chain and cannot block board-wide blasts unless explicitly specified.
rules.cooldowns: Cooldown X means the active is unusable for the next X of that unit's own activations after use. CD 0 may be used on every activation. Every activation may use at most one special or one basic attack.
rules.duration: Unless explicitly otherwise, next activation statuses end after the affected unit completes its next activation. Round statuses end after both sides have exhausted available unit activations.
rules.stacking: Same-type buffs/debuffs take the strongest active instance; they do not stack. Shield points retain only the larger value. Armor has hard cap 4 after buffs, minimum 0.
rules.collision: Forced move fails if target destination is occupied, blocking or outside the map, unless ability explicitly deals collision damage. Cannot displace enemy LEADER off board for victory.
rules.training_tokens: SPAWN tokens have 2 HP, 0 ARM, basic attack 2 at range 1-2, STEP 2 unless the unit explicitly describes otherwise; they do not use active abilities, cannot be captured for economy, and despawn after battle.

planetary: wall: blocks ray and normal movement
rough: +1 movement cost per hex unless ignored
objective: claim by ending activation on hex; one controlling unit per hex
orbital: asteroid: -1 ranged damage if target behind low debris
large wreck: blocks normal straight paths/LOS
nebula: reduces sight by 1 for units inside unless immune

rules.equipment_upgrades: Unlock tier 1-5 is when the unit becomes available; weapon/armor research can upgrade existing unit without changing its movement identity. Proposed: weapon tier 3 adds +1 base damage, tier 5 adds a further +1. Armor tier 2/3/4/5 each add +1 printed HP; tier 3 adds +1 ARM and tier 5 another +1 (subject to cap 4). Applies equally to equivalent fleets as a starting balance model.
rules.faction_ability_note: Faction rules are separate from unit active and passive abilities. Inhumanus charter is a strategic pre-battle selection, not an option to switch freely inside a battle.

movement_patterns.STEP: Move along an unoccupied, connected hex path with up to N steps. Can change direction freely.
movement_patterns.RAY: Move straight along one of the six hex axes up to N hexes; may not turn mid-move.
movement_patterns.ZIGZAG: Move along an unoccupied hex path of up to N steps and make at most one 60-degree turn.
movement_patterns.DIAG: Move along a straight corner-to-corner diagonal, using the six axial offset directions (1,1), (2,-1), (1,-2), (-1,-1), (-2,1), (-1,2). Each diagonal hop has hex distance 2; N counts diagonal hops, not ordinary steps.
movement_patterns.KNIGHT: Jump to a hex at 2*a+b where a is a primary hex direction and b is either immediately adjacent direction. Twelve possible offsets, skipping blockers and landing only on legal empty hexes; N is nominal range 3.
movement_patterns.LEAP: Jump to any empty hex within N hexes, skipping intervening units and low obstacles; cannot cross an explicitly anti-jump barrier or leave board.
movement_patterns.PHASE: Follow a STEP-style route of up to N, passing through units and cover; cannot end on an occupied or impassable destination.

effect_codes.AOE: Strike a selected center hex and adjacent hexes as stated by that specific unit. Unless stated otherwise, blast damage can hit allies.
effect_codes.ARMOR_BREAK: Reduce target armor by the specified amount for one activation, usually via EXPOSED.
effect_codes.BARRAGE: Resolve a defined sequence of separate damage hits, each with its own legal target. Can never hit one target twice unless text expressly permits it.
effect_codes.BARRIER: Create or restore a battlefield cover or wall piece with stated HP and duration.
effect_codes.BOARD: Apply BOARDED status to a qualifying weakened target. It is not automatic permanent ownership in battle.
effect_codes.BOMBARD: Deal area damage centered on a visible hex, including over low cover when text allows. Resolve each hex once.
effect_codes.CAPTURE: Apply CAPTURED to an adjacent non-leader below the stated HP threshold; captured targets remain on board but cannot act.
effect_codes.CHARGE: Move then strike as one special action according to the specified line, distance and damage. No extra basic attack.
effect_codes.CLOAK: Apply CLOAKED status for described duration.
effect_codes.CONVERT: Transform a previously CAPTURED non-leader into a temporary 1-HP Cräigon auxiliary; requires uninterrupted action.
effect_codes.COUNTER: Return damage in response to a triggering attack one time. It never chains into another counter.
effect_codes.DAMAGE: Single-target active damage, substituting for a basic attack on that activation.
effect_codes.DASH: Reposition as part of a special action; only deals damage when the unit text says it does.
effect_codes.DEBUFF: Apply the exact listed weakening status to eligible units.
effect_codes.DISABLE: Apply DISABLED unless text explicitly also prevents basic attacks.
effect_codes.GUARD: Grant direct-attack interception, max once per guardian per round.
effect_codes.HEAL: Restore printed HP to a friendly eligible unit, never beyond max; may cleanse a status if explicitly stated.
effect_codes.INTERCEPT: Make a declared protective reaction on the next eligible hostile attack, per the unit text.
effect_codes.LEAP: Special movement jump to indicated legal destination and any stated related attack.
effect_codes.MARK: Apply a one-use damage amplification or tactical designation.
effect_codes.MINE: Place a visible-to-owner, hidden-to-opponent mine with a deterministic trigger and damage amount.
effect_codes.PIERCE: Deal the listed damage, ignoring the stated number of armor points, not shields unless specified.
effect_codes.PIN: Apply ROOTED for the specified time.
effect_codes.PULL: Displace a target by the stated number of hexes toward source, if the landing hex is empty and not blocked.
effect_codes.RALLY: Provide the specified attack, movement, or defensive buff to named allies; no stacking of identical buffs.
effect_codes.REPAIR: Restore HP to vehicles or constructs, not above their printed maximum.
effect_codes.REPOSITION: Relocate eligible ally or self as the ability describes; cannot place units onto enemies or blocked hexes.
effect_codes.REVEAL: Reveal stealth, mines, and hidden targets within the listed area for a defined duration.
effect_codes.SHIELD: Grant temporary shield HP for the listed duration.
effect_codes.SPAWN: Place a weak deployable token in an empty adjacent hex, respecting per-carrier cap; tokens never count as LEADERS.
effect_codes.SUPPRESS: Reduce a target's next-activation movement by an explicitly stated amount.
effect_codes.TELEPORT: Relocate unit to a legal empty target hex, ignoring intervening terrain but never the endpoint restrictions.

status_definitions.ARM: Flat armor reduction from each damage instance, before temporary shields are applied; base cap 4. Minimum direct-attack damage is 0.
status_definitions.HP: Printed health. A unit is defeated at 0 HP. Temporary shield points absorb damage before health; each new shield source refreshes to the greater amount rather than stacking.
status_definitions.COVER: A blocking terrain hex ends movement and line of sight; low-cover terrain reduces ranged damage by 1. A unit can attack out of its own low-cover hex.
status_definitions.ROOTED: Cannot move during its next activation; can attack or use a non-movement ability unless DISABLED.
status_definitions.DISABLED: Cannot use its active ability on its next activation. It may still move or use a basic attack unless the particular active explicitly forbids attacks too.
status_definitions.EXPOSED: Armor reduced by 1 (minimum 0) until the end of the target's next activation, unless an ability specifies a shorter period.
status_definitions.MARKED: The next qualifying friendly attack against the target gets the listed raw damage bonus. It is then consumed. Same-kind marks never stack; the strongest applies.
status_definitions.CLOAKED: Invisible and untargetable by enemies farther than 2 hexes unless exposed by REVEAL. Breaks if the unit attacks, uses an offensive active, or ends adjacent to an enemy.
status_definitions.GUARD: One unit is allowed to redirect one eligible direct attack away from a specified friendly target. Guardian must be within its protection range, present, alive, and not DISABLED. A redirected attack hits the guardian; no reaction chain is permitted.
status_definitions.SHIELD: Temporary shield HP is consumed before normal HP. A shield expires at its specified duration. Multiple shields keep only the greatest current shield value.
status_definitions.CAPTURED: Unit is immobilized and cannot act or exert zone control. It can be freed by adjacent allied rescue action unless affected by an explicit specialist rule; it has no command function.
status_definitions.BOARDED: Ship is grappled and cannot activate until an ally removes boarding via an adjacent rescue action, or the boarding unit is defeated. Flagships still require a legal lethal attack for victory.
status_definitions.SALVAGEABLE: A destroyed hull may be reclaimed in the post-battle campaign layer if a qualified salvage unit survives and the faction controls the battle site. Not a mid-fight resurrection.
status_definitions.SUPPRESSED: Movement maximum is reduced by the specified amount for the next activation, to a minimum of 1 unless ROOTED.
status_definitions.BARRIER: Temporary occupiable or blocking map structure, with its own HP and expiry. Blocking barriers obstruct movement and line of sight unless ability says otherwise.

factions.identity: Telepathic bio-engineers who capture enemies and impose The Gift. Durable infantry, precise disabling attacks, weaker mass destruction.
factions.rule: Collective Link: adjacent Cräigon infantry can use each other for friendly support ranges; Gift conversions create Cräigon bio-forms rather than using captured foreign weapons.

factions.identity: Silicon-crystal monarchy: formidable armor, living fortifications, slow advance, defensive capital ships.
factions.rule: Living Stone: while a Silex unit ends its activation without moving, it gets +1 temporary guard armor until its next activation (non-stacking).

factions.identity: Gnome-dwarf war foundries; swift infantry and light ships, ruthless aggression, destructive weaponry, fragile defenses.
factions.rule: War Momentum: first Pygmaei unit to defeat an enemy in a round may immediately step 1 free hex if legal; this is not another attack.

factions.identity: Multispecies coalition, defensive diplomacy, adaptable formations, nonlethal options and field support.
factions.rule: Coalition Cover: allied units occupying adjacent hexes may donate one GUARD intercept each round when their own ability or passive explicitly permits it.

factions.identity: Hyper-capitalist low-gravity technologists relying on gravity manipulation, contracted assets, drones and locked military specialization.
factions.rule: Corporate Charter: one strategic specialization (Assault, Bulwark, Naval or Commerce) is locked before deployment; the battle roster reflects that choice.

factions.identity: Mixed-species privateers with heavy broadsides, boarding, scavenging, raiding and volatile crews.
factions.rule: Claim the Wreck: ships marked SALVAGEABLE can be reclaimed after battle by surviving salvage-capable pirate units, never resurrected mid-battle.
